reason: While I appreciate the transparent flat pricing of ₹12,990 with no per-user fees, as a partner managing confidential client audits I cannot risk paying upfront until I verify that connecting Google Drive won't expose our firm's existing private files. I would only test the free pilot first to inspect the permissions before spending any money.
objection: Will connecting my Google Drive give Docketra access to read all my firm's private files outside the dedicated folder?
would_change_my_mind: Verifiable proof during the free pilot showing that Google OAuth permissions physically isolate Docketra to only the /Docketra/ folder with zero access to our private files.
